# Security policy

Do not open a public issue containing a private document, credential, exploit against a live deployment, or personal data. Report security/privacy concerns privately to the repository owner with the affected version, impact, metadata-only reproduction, and a synthetic sample when possible.

The supported release is the most recent tagged version. The local Compose profile binds to loopback and is not an authenticated public service. Remote exposure, custom personas, or external providers require the controls in `docs/deployment.md` and `docs/threat-model.md`.

Please do not test systems or documents you do not own or have explicit permission to assess.
